svg.text: DeepSpeed ZeRO-1 / 2 / 3: what ONE rank holds during one optimizer step of K microbatches
FP32 model, client AdamW, W ranks, sized buckets · P = model parameters in FP32 (4Ψ bytes) · B = reduction bucket · A = activations of one microbatch · G = gathered module parameters
Heights drawn for W = 2 (today's run); A and G not to scale. Microbatches 1 … K−2 repeat columns 2–4 on top of what column 4 carries.
Start of step: z3 − z1 = (5P/W + B) − (P + 3P/W) = B − P(1 − 2/W). At W = 2 stage 3 starts B higher (pre-test: +25.2 MiB over z2); for W > 2 it starts lower once P(1 − 2/W) > B.
Between microbatches z1 carries P + B, z2 carries P/W, z3 carries nothing extra; arrows ← mark the tensor the step rewrites (flat params, or the partition in z3).
